items.name: Tesla K80 era
items.description: Baseline era for cloud GPU acceleration before tensor-core specialization.

items.name: V100
items.description: Tensor Cores make mixed-precision AI a first-class accelerator workload.

items.name: A100
items.description: Datacenter AI consolidation around versatile training/inference accelerators.

items.name: H100
items.description: Transformer-engine era and large-scale HBM systems.

items.name: Blackwell
items.description: System-level scaling and low-precision AI become central design targets.

items.name: 1 GbE
items.description: Gigabit Ethernet becomes mainstream in servers and enterprise networks.

items.name: 10 GbE
items.description: Datacenter fabrics move beyond gigabit bottlenecks.

items.name: 100 GbE
items.description: Leaf-spine networks scale for modern cloud workloads.

items.name: 400 GbE
items.description: High-bandwidth cluster fabrics support large AI and analytics systems.

items.name: 800 GbE
items.description: AI clusters accelerate adoption of very high bandwidth optical interconnects.

items.name: 4G LTE
items.description: Mobile broadband becomes a general-purpose internet access layer.

items.name: 5G
items.description: Higher bandwidth and lower latency expand mobile and fixed-wireless use cases.

items.name: LCD dominance
items.description: Thin LCD panels become standard across laptops and smartphones.

items.name: OLED mainstream phones
items.description: Per-pixel emission improves contrast and enables thinner flexible displays.

items.name: Mini-LED premium LCD
items.description: Dense local dimming improves HDR while retaining LCD architecture.

items.name: Tandem OLED
items.description: Stacked emissive layers target higher brightness and efficiency.

items.name: Fossil-heavy grids
items.description: Datacenter footprint depended heavily on local grid mix.

items.name: Wind + solar scaling
items.description: Rapid renewable deployment changes siting and procurement strategies.

items.name: Nuclear / firm clean power renewed interest
items.description: 24/7 clean-power needs increase attention on nuclear, hydro, storage and firm generation.

items.name: AI datacenter power constraint
items.description: Power availability, grid interconnection, cooling and embodied carbon become first-class architecture constraints.
